meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 就多了一组 Gmail 工具:能读邮件、搜邮件、发邮件、写草稿、下载附件,还能管理标签和过滤器。真实登录凭据不会明文存到容器或磁盘,而是由 OneCLI 在每次请求时临时注入。
howto.when: 当你说要让 Claude 接入 Gmail(如读邮件、发邮件、管理标签)时,这个技能会启动配置流程。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签
say.note: 会调用 Gmail 的标签工具。

say.text: 搜一下我上个月的发票邮件
say.note: 会搜索收件箱并返回结果。

say.text: 帮我给客户写一封邮件草稿
say.note: 会使用草稿工具生成内容。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gets a set of Gmail MCP tools: read, search, send, draft emails, download attachments, manage labels and filters. Real credentials are never in plaintext on disk/container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.
howto.when_en: This skill starts when you ask to connect Gmail to Claude, e.g. to read emails, send emails, or manage labels.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for last month's invoices.
Draft an email to my client.
